## 2. Bab Al-Khaleej (Kingdom of Bahrain)

Private corporate services and document coordination consultancy supporting international and local founders in Bahrain.

### Advisory Scope (VERIFY against official source: Sijilat, MOIC, NPRA, LMRA)
1. **Commercial Registration (CR) Support**:
   - Guidance on ISIC business activity selection, trade name reservation, Memorandum of Association (MOA) preparation, and municipal address coordination via Sijilat (https://www.sijilat.bh).
   - Rules on 100% foreign ownership eligibility and legal forms (W.L.L., S.P.C., Foreign Branch) vary by ISIC activity — VERIFY against official source (Sijilat, MOIC).
2. **Investor & Partner Residency Coordination**:
   - Advisory on self-sponsored shareholder residence permits and Bahrain Golden Residency eligibility criteria — VERIFY against official source (NPRA, MOIC).
3. **LMRA Work Permits & Workforce Administration**:
   - Support with LMRA quota applications, work permit filings, medical examination scheduling, biometric appointments, and CPR smart card coordination — VERIFY against official source (LMRA, NPRA).
4. **Document Clearance & Attestation**:
   - Coordination of certified translations, notary scheduling, and MOFA / embassy document attestation.
5. **Pricing & Timelines**:
